findings.description: During the first aerial trick, two skateboards are visible simultaneously: one deck with visible trucks/white wheels angled under the skater's rear foot, and a second dark deck (with a visible yellow logo on its graphic side) floating vertically above/beside his front leg. A single rider can only have one board at a time, so one of these decks is an unexplained duplicate.
